scope: Exercise the installed full checked-record C caller through two real native sessions or two real Wasmtime instances. Source qualification does not establish installed runtime acceptance.

checks: Reject borrowed checked Claims in both session directions without changing output bytes or publishing an owner.
Reject a foreign second argument and a foreign later array element; preserve the copied and owned input fields.
Reject a foreign second transfer owner before consuming either input; preserve both original owner identities and recover.

Reject foreign callback replies both before and after transfer. A post-transfer failure must consume its input owner, reject a stale release, preserve an independent retain and leave output untouched.
Reject a returned closure in another session and a foreign input to a local closure; then accept a valid local call.
Reject a resource after its original owner is released while an independent retain remains usable.
Reject calls through a closed session, release its remaining owner, reopen a distinct session and reject old resource identities.
Keep the primary session usable after every failure and peer shutdown.

headerChecks.description: Existing generator checks compile the complete C and C++ callers against generated native headers, the shared C caller against the original smaller native header, and the transformed C caller against full/result-only WIT headers with -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fsyntax-only.
